about_the_game:
FIRE: The First Dreamer – Demo

Begin the journey in a land where the veil between dream and memory grows thin. In this first glimpse of FIRE: The First Dreamer, your path opens with a choice — one that will shape your first encounter with the ancient forces that still stir beneath the surface.

Step into a living fragment of the world, a tenth of the vast wilderness that stretches across the Preseli mountains. Here, you’ll uncover the earliest embers of a forgotten pact between humans and the spirits of the land.  The totem animals are watching. The Dragon dreams.

Survive the fading light, and as your first night descends, you may glimpse the Dragon stirring in the shadows.

This is only the beginning — but the Fire already knows your name.

FEATURES (Demo)

🌿 First Choice: Begin your journey with a fateful decision that leads to a vision — a fragment of what may come, or a warning of what once was.

🌄 Exploration and Survival: Roam a rich and atmospheric portion of the open world — around 10% of the full map — filled with natural beauty, and danger.

🌀 Totemic Glimpses: Encounter the first signs of the totem animals and feel the stirrings of their ancient power.

🔥 Dream as Guidance: Let Fire shape your path, revealing hints of the deeper journey yet to come.

🌬️ Elemental Immersion: Experience a world shaped by wind, stone, and flame — where shifting skies, ancient ruins, and living landscapes tell their own stories.

🐾 Living Legacy: Begin to uncover the myth that binds all things — a story whispered through dreams, symbols, and the land itself.
